title: Unlicensed possession or use of stamps.
bodyText: A person who is not licensed under this chapter and who knowingly [possesses] or uses a stamp shall be guilty of a class B felony.
bodyHtml: [§245-35]  Unlicensed possession or use of stamps.  A person who is not licensed under this chapter and who knowingly [possesses] or uses a stamp shall be guilty of a class B felony. [L 2000, c 249, pt of §1, §20(2); am L 2002, c 94, §3]
